description.en-US: Hugh’s nineteen homilies on Ecclesiastes, read with the Preacher’s question what profit a man has from his toil. Latin only, from the Migne text (Patrologia Latina 175, 1854), a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: As dezenove homilias de Hugo sobre o Eclesiastes.

sources.edition: Migne, Patrologia Latina 175 (Paris 1854); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), text HuDeSVi.HoInEc, from the machine-corrected OCR of the Open Greek and Latin project.
sources.description: The complete PL text with its chapter divisions. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and the PL tables of chapters (which repeat the chapter headings) are not imported. The OCR carries a few residual slips.
sources.tierEvidence: Migne’s Patrologia Latina (1854–1855) prints the medieval text; public domain everywhere.
